Familiar, Rabbit
This small, furry creature has long ears and oversized feet.
Rabbit CR 1/6
Source Ultimate Wilderness pg. 204, Animal Archive pg. 31
XP 65
N Tiny animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +1
Defense
AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 3 (1d8–1)
Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +1
Offense
Speed 50 ft.
Melee bite –2 (1d3–4)
Space 2-1/2 ft., Reach 0 ft.
Statistics
Str 3, Dex 16, Con 9, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 5
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 7
Feats Run
Skills Acrobatics +0 (+8 when jumping), Stealth +15
Ecology
Environment temperate plains
Organization solitary, pair, or down (3–16)
Treasure none
Description
Rabbits are herbivores with short tails, long ears for sensing predators, and powerful hind legs that allow them to leap quickly to safety when threatened.

An average rabbit is between 8 and 20 inches long and weighs 1 to 4 pounds.
